Prevention: Plough soil 2-3 times to expose larvae.
Let the soil dry for 7-10 days to kill some eggs and larvae.
Rotate crop with crops from different plant families that are not attracted by flea beetle.
Remove crop residues by burning or composting.

Monitoring: Check young plants 2 times per week.
